function.name: submit_review
function.arguments: {"is_bug":true,"summary":"The code executes, but the Fourier cross-validation leaks information across contiguous phase blocks: its three-harmonic model is evaluated by training on all other blocks and extrapolating into each held-out interval, so exceptionally high scores do not establish a robust phase-locked trajectory. More importantly, the mean-phase scan includes both phase endpoints (0 and 2π) as separate observations; modeling them as ordinary points is acceptable descriptively but endpoint agreement/closure is never reported despite being central to the proposed question. Fix by using the prespecified blocked comparison cautiously (or a valid periodic validation design), and explicitly quantify endpoint-direction difference; note that row order as acquisition order is unknown."}
